title: /deployments/health/read discloses the effective probe interval and the browser decoder preserves it
description:
SPIDR child of task-078232fb9b9d4c06a5faf3c02adaf705, cut by architect-5ac70ba8 on 2026-09-07. THIS ROW TAKES the parent's DoD 4 verbatim; the parent keeps DoD 1's durable record, DoD 2 and DoD 3. dependsOn the parent because there is no effective interval to disclose until the parent lands the record and the default.

MEASURED AT HEAD by architect-5ac70ba8 (2026-09-07 ~13:20Z), and it settles the parent DoD 4's own conditional:
- The parent's DoD 4 said "once task-509c6c16 lands, else the current read". task-509c6c16 IS DONE ("HTTP /deployments/health/read serves environment state, the last error line and the open incident, composed into the production listener"). So this row binds to `/deployments/health/read`, not to a fallback.
- The browser client already exists: `apps/control-room/src/live/live-deployments-health.ts:21` exports `DEPLOYMENTS_HEALTH_READ_PATH = "/deployments/health/read"`, pinned at `live-deployments-health.test.ts:150` and rostered in `dev-proxy-paths.ts:28` and `live-document-proxy.test.ts:26`.

THE DECODER IS STRICTLY EXACT - READ THIS BEFORE DESIGNING THE WIRE. The control-room live decoders use an `exactDataRecord(value, expectedKeys)` helper that refuses when `keys.length !== expectedKeys.length`. There is NO optional-key path, so a new member must be emitted on EVERY row, always. Encode "unset" as an in-band value (the effective interval is always a number - the stored one or the 60000 default), never by omitting the key: an omitted key fails the length check and the WHOLE row decodes to null, blanking the screen rather than degrading one field. See Serena memory `decision-a-strictly-exact-wire-decoder-forces-an-always-emitted-key` for the full rule and the fixture-census recipe.

NOT IN SCOPE: the durable record, the store port, the scheduler and boot re-registration (the parent's), and the operator command kind (the sibling row filed alongside this one).
definitionOfDone: `/deployments/health/read` serves the EFFECTIVE probe interval per environment - the stored value when set, the 60000 default when unset - read through the port task-078232fb lands, never recomputed in the read.

The value is asserted against what was WRITTEN through the port and read back, never against a fixture constant the test also seeded - a self-agreeing assertion passes even when the read ignores the record.

The browser decoder in `apps/control-room/src/live/live-deployments-health.ts` preserves the member with EXACT-KEY decoding: an unknown key and a missing key each refuse with the specific code AND the layer that refused, and a malformed value fails closed rather than dropping the member silently.
Two environments with DIFFERENT stored intervals are disclosed separately and asserted by value - a read that serves one environment's interval for another passes every single-environment fixture.

Every fixture constructing the health view is backfilled for the new required member (census the literals, do not rely on the type name alone - a type-only import does not break). Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`.
